description.narrative: Karian Water Supply Project involves the development, construction, operation, and maintenance of greenfield water supply facilities in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia (4,600 litre/second water treatment plant and 20-km transmission pipeline). The Project will supply fresh water to three cities across two provinces: DKI Jakarta, Tangerang, and South Tangerang. PT Karian Water Services (KWS) will undertake the Project under a 34-year Public-Private Partnership (PPP) concession with the Ministry of Public Works & Housing as the Government Contracting Agency (GCA).

The main project-level outcomes are from: (i) stakeholder effects by increasing access to piped water through an additional 4,600 liter/second of bulk water supply capacity in DKI Jakarta, Tangerang and South Tangerang that are experiencing water supply deficit; as well as (ii) environmental effects by helping reduce groundwater extraction which contributes to land subsidence in one of the worlds fastest sinking cities. Beyond the Project, the investment is expected to increase market competitiveness by supporting the first internationally financed PPP in the water sector in Indonesia, demonstrating significant improvements on the bankability of key project documents which are expected to serve as a template for future PPPs in the water sector.

name.narrative: The water treatment plant (WTP) site is a greenfield site located in Jelupang subdistrict, South Tangerang City, adjacent to Kunciran Serpong Toll Road. The treated water transmission pipeline will stretch from the Karian WTP in South Tangerang City to four offtake points in West Jakarta, Tangerang City, and South Tangerang City.
